services.name: Tenancy
services.purpose: Организации, членство, роли и допуск к складам
services.boundary: Не хранит пароли; Keycloak аутентифицирует, Tenancy решает бизнес-доступ.

tables.memberships: id, org_id, subject_id, role, depot_id?, status, version
tables.audit_entries: id, org_id, actor_id, action, target_id, occurred_at

services.failure: Недоступность Tenancy блокирует новые бизнес-команды (503), чтения возможны с membership snapshot не старше 60 s.
services.scale: Stateless HTTP replicas; membership lookup indexes; no shared auth cache without bounded revocation.
services.tests: Два tenant, отозванная роль, чужой depot, audit without token data

services.name: Catalog
services.purpose: Модели оборудования, тарифы и неизменяемые котировки
services.boundary: Не утверждает наличие экземпляров и не владеет денежными проводками.

tables.models: id, org_id, name, category, active, version
tables.rates: id, org_id, model_id, daily_minor, deposit_minor, currency, valid_from, version
tables.quotes: id, org_id, model_id, depot_id, start_at, end_at, quantity, days, daily_minor, rental_minor, deposit_minor, currency, expires_at, rate_version

services.failure: При падении Catalog новый checkout не начинается; подтверждение уже сохранённой котировки не требует повторного расчёта.
services.scale: Cache-aside Redis for model lists only; immutable quotes stored in PostgreSQL.
services.tests: Изменение тарифа после quote, округление вверх, timezone, quantity limits

services.name: Inventory
services.purpose: Экземпляры, временные allocations, holds, ремонт и доступность
services.boundary: Единственный авторитет по пересечению интервалов; Availability UI — подсказка.

tables.assets: id, org_id, model_id, depot_id, serial, state, version
tables.holds: id, org_id, booking_id, expires_at, status, version
tables.allocations: id, org_id, asset_id, hold_id?, booking_id?, kind, period, active, version
tables.maintenance_jobs: id, org_id, asset_id, reason, status, version

services.failure: Если Inventory недоступен, booking остаётся pending; никогда не предполагает успешный резерв по timeout.
services.scale: Выбор экземпляров в стабильном порядке; locks и exclusion invariant; replicas не обходят БД.
services.tests: 100 checkout на один asset; hold expiration/commit race; ремонт против резерва

services.name: Booking
services.purpose: Договор аренды, saga подтверждения и отмены, проекция истории
services.boundary: Оркестратор процесса; не меняет чужие таблицы и не решает наличие сам.

tables.bookings: id, org_id, customer_id, quote_id, quote_snapshot, status, version, created_at
tables.sagas: id, org_id, booking_id, phase, deadline_at, cancel_requested, version
tables.timeline_entries: id, org_id, booking_id, source_event_id, type, at

services.failure: Saga state persists before publishing; restart resumes. Unknown payment state leads to reconciliation, not a second charge.
services.scale: Scheduler row leases; optimistic version; event handlers per booking serialized at DB.
services.tests: Поздняя авторизация, cancel vs commit, crash after write, event reordering

services.name: Billing
services.purpose: Sandbox payment intent, authorization, capture, refund и ledger
services.boundary: Только симулированный PSP; никакие PAN/CVV, реальные платежи или обещания юридической корректности.

tables.payment_intents: id, org_id, booking_id, customer_id, authorized_minor, captured_minor, refunded_minor, pending_refund_minor, status, provider_key, version
tables.payment_operations: id, org_id, intent_id, kind, amount_minor, provider_key, status, attempt, version
tables.ledger_entries: id, org_id, intent_id, operation_id, kind, amount_minor, created_at

services.failure: Timeout PSP означает UNKNOWN. Запрос по provider_key и reconcile; не трактовать как decline.
services.scale: Intent lock + unique operation; webhook rate limit; PSP call outside long DB lock.
services.tests: Duplicate webhook, invalid signature, capture+refund bounds, provider processed but response lost

services.name: Fulfillment
services.purpose: Складская выдача, inspection возврата и акт состояния
services.boundary: Подтверждает физическое действие; не запускает новую аренду и не переписывает hold.

tables.jobs: id, org_id, booking_id, customer_id, depot_id, asset_ids, start_at, end_at, status, version
tables.handover_records: id, org_id, job_id, asset_ids, actor_id, occurred_at
tables.return_reports: id, org_id, job_id, condition, late_days, damage_minor, notes, version

services.failure: При stale projection перед выдачей проверить Booking синхронно; при его недоступности выдачу блокировать. Возврат уже выданного job записывается локально.
services.scale: Optimistic job version; one handover per job; warehouse-specific replicas unnecessary initially.
services.tests: Cancel vs handover fence; wrong depot operator; double return; damage escalation

services.name: Notification
services.purpose: Внутренние уведомления, доставка email и предпочтения
services.boundary: Отказ уведомления не откатывает аренду; история аренды остаётся в Booking.

tables.notifications: id, org_id, subject_id, source_event_id, title, read_at
tables.deliveries: id, org_id, notification_id, channel, status, attempt, next_attempt_at

services.failure: Почта недоступна: retries, DLQ, UI notification сохранён. Email exactly-once не обещается.
services.scale: TypeScript Node.js workers; bounded concurrency, own Postgres and inbox.
services.tests: Duplicate event creates one notification; sink timeout; tenant isolation of SSE

stories.title: Доступ организации
stories.main: Пригласить участника; назначить одну роль и при необходимости depot
stories.alternative: Отозвать membership; следующий command запрещён
stories.errors: Чужой org или depot -> 404/403
stories.acceptance: Given A/B; When member A GET booking B; Then 404 и тело без PII. Revocation запрещает команды сразу после authoritative check, чтения ≤60 s.

stories.title: Каталог и тариф
stories.main: Создать model и rate в EUR minor units; заменить rate новым version
stories.alternative: Deactivate model скрывает новые quotes, не ломает существующие
stories.errors: Нулевая/отрицательная стоимость или inactive model -> 422
stories.acceptance: Given rate 2500; When rate changes to 3000 after quote; Then existing quote uses 2500 until expiry.

stories.title: Поиск доступности
stories.main: Выбрать depot, start/end, quantity; фильтр категории, cursor pagination
stories.alternative: Нет единиц -> empty state; Redis down -> SQL
stories.errors: start>=end, quantity вне 1..5 ->422
stories.acceptance: When 26 models with page limit 25; Then second cursor returns last item without duplicate. Availability never guarantees allocation.

stories.title: Котировка
stories.main: Quote expires after 15 min; days=ceil(duration/24h); quantity multiplied
stories.alternative: Quote expired -> refresh with explicit consent if amount changes
stories.errors: Вход содержит decimal money or negative duration ->422
stories.acceptance: Given 25 h, qty2, rate2500, deposit10000 per unit; Then days2, rental10000, deposit20000, total authorization30000.

stories.title: Временный резерв
stories.main: Booking pending -> reserve command; Inventory holds exact assets 10 min
stories.alternative: Недостаточно units -> rejected; no partial holds
stories.errors: 100 concurrent commands contend -> one wins for qty1/one asset
stories.acceptance: Given one asset; When 100 unique bookings overlap; Then exactly 1 hold, 99 rejections, zero overlapping active allocations.

stories.title: Подтверждение аренды
stories.main: HoldCreated -> authorize; Authorized -> commit; Committed -> confirmed
stories.alternative: Transient faults leave pending/reconciling; customer sees status
stories.errors: Expiry before commit -> release and void; never confirm expired hold
stories.acceptance: Given authorization succeeds and allocation commits; Then one confirmed booking, one active allocation, one authorization; 10 duplicate events change none of these counts.

stories.title: Идемпотентность команд
stories.main: Store request hash and durable response per org+subject+route+key 24h
stories.alternative: Same hash returns same resource/status; processing ->202
stories.errors: Same key different body ->409 idempotency_mismatch
stories.acceptance: When retry 20 times after response loss; Then one booking and one operation; tenant B may reuse same key independently.

stories.title: Отмена до выдачи
stories.prerequisites: F06; pending or confirmed, not handed over
stories.main: Record cancellation intent under booking lock; saga releases allocation and voids authorization
stories.alternative: Late authorized event triggers void even after cancellation
stories.errors: Handover claimed or handed_over ->409 cannot_cancel
stories.acceptance: When cancel races allocation commit; Then terminal cancelled eventually has no active allocation and net captured0; timeout alone is not cancelled completion.

stories.title: Складская выдача
stories.prerequisites: F06; same depot; now in pickup window start-1h..end
stories.main: Claim handover atomically in Booking then Fulfillment records act
stories.alternative: Lost response: query claim, resume same job, never release automatically
stories.errors: Missing allocation, revoked operator, cancellation won ->409/403
stories.acceptance: When cancel and handover claim race; Then exactly one wins. Double handover returns original act; different payload ->409.

stories.title: Возврат и inspection
stories.main: Record return once; condition good/damaged; Inventory releases or quarantines; Booking starts settlement
stories.alternative: Offline dependencies -> queued event; partial returns excluded core
stories.errors: Damage above deposit -> manual_review, no automatic extra debit
stories.acceptance: When return event delivered 10 times; Then one report, one release, one settlement; damaged asset not bookable until repair.

stories.title: Завершение оплаты
stories.main: Capture rental+late+damage within authorized bound; remainder void; ledger persists
stories.alternative: Provider unknown -> reconciling and operator alert
stories.errors: Overdeposit total -> manual_review; never overcapture
stories.acceptance: Given authorized15000, rental5000, late2500, damage1000; Then capture8500 and void remaining6500, captured-refunded=8500.

stories.title: Возврат списанных средств
stories.main: Reason mandatory; idempotent refund ≤ remaining captured; webhook verifies result
stories.alternative: Timeout queries PSP before retry
stories.errors: Customer role ->403; refund over remainder ->422
stories.acceptance: When two concurrent full refunds; Then total refunded ≤ captured and one succeeds; second conflicts.

stories.title: Ремонт
stories.main: Create maintenance allocation for non-rented asset; complete repair explicitly
stories.alternative: Future reservations conflict -> reject and show affected booking IDs for dispatcher
stories.errors: Already handed_over ->409; cannot delete existing bookings
stories.acceptance: When maintenance period overlaps a committed booking; Then409 and no maintenance insert; after successful repair new hold is permitted.

stories.title: Уведомления и realtime
stories.main: Durable notification, SSE with cursor, email sink retry
stories.alternative: SSE disconnected -> reconnect then HTTP snapshot; email fail does not fail booking
stories.errors: Cross-tenant SSE cursor ->404; unknown cursor -> fresh snapshot
stories.acceptance: Given confirmed event duplicated; Then one UI notification; SSE reconnect recovers latest state; email failure leaves confirmed.

stories.title: История и audit
stories.main: Timeline with source event and correlation; auth decisions audit separately
stories.alternative: Read projection lag displayed with updated_at
stories.errors: Secrets, tokens, full email never written to telemetry
stories.acceptance: When investigate failed booking; Then actor, before/after state, correlation and saga phase are recoverable; timeline rows unique by source event.

stories.title: Обновление конкурирующих форм
stories.main: If-Match version on modifications; 412 with refetch action
stories.alternative: User reloads and explicitly repeats action
stories.errors: Missing If-Match ->428; stale ->412
stories.acceptance: When two forms edit same asset at v3; Then first creates v4, second412 and cannot overwrite.

stories.title: Контракты и эволюция
stories.main: Add optional field; provider and old consumer contract suite run
stories.alternative: Breaking meaning -> v2 route/event, overlap deployments
stories.errors: Required field removal or enum narrowing -> CI failure
stories.acceptance: Given old consumer fixture; When optional field added; Then both deserialize; breaking fixture rejected before release.

stories.title: Восстановление после сбоя
stories.prerequisites: M08; broker and PSP faults injectable
stories.main: Inspect saga and inbox/outbox; controlled DLQ replay retains event ID
stories.alternative: Poison payload quarantined with original metadata
stories.errors: Blindly mark success or new charge -> forbidden
stories.acceptance: Given crash after DB commit before ACK; When restarted and replayed; Then one business effect and no lost transition.

stories.title: Независимая поставка
stories.main: Pipeline builds changed service + reverse contract dependents; deploy digest, smoke, rollback
stories.alternative: Failed readiness -> old deployment remains
stories.errors: Migration destructive in same release -> blocked
stories.acceptance: When deploy Notification only; Then six core service digests stay unchanged; rollback restores prior image without DB loss.

stories.title: Резервное копирование
stories.main: Backup all owned stores and record cutover times; restore to isolated namespace; reconcile saga/provider
stories.alternative: Unequal backup timestamps -> report and recovery queue
stories.errors: Restore into active prod namespace -> forbidden
stories.acceptance: When restore controlled checkpoint; Then known booking counts, ledger balance and allocation invariants match checkpoint; measured RTO≤30min and snapshot RPO≤24h.

nfr.title: Latency
nfr.acceptance: На lab-standard: 20 virtual users, 10 min after 2min warmup; read p95≤300ms, command acceptance p95≤500ms; saga completion p95≤5s при здоровом PSP; error<1% excluding expected409/422.

nfr.title: Integrity
nfr.acceptance: 100 concurrent overlapping bookings on one asset produce exactly one committed allocation. Zero overlap, overcapture and duplicate refund across 10k duplicate/reordered deliveries.

nfr.title: Tenant isolation
nfr.acceptance: Two organizations × all role/endpoint pairs; no foreign records, events, SSE or cache entries; 401/403/404 verified before access.

nfr.title: Recovery
nfr.acceptance: Broker outage120s, consumer killed after DB commit beforeACK; pending saga reconciles ≤120s after recovery for 100 bookings; DLQ poison remains quarantined.

nfr.title: Observability
nfr.acceptance: 100% synthetic test traces sampled; booking→outbox→consumer→PSP causality queryable; logs correlate; metrics have no booking/customer label.

nfr.title: Availability target
nfr.acceptance: Lab SLO 99% successful eligible commands over 1h controlled run (denominator excludes auth/validation/conflict; includes dependency5xx). No claim about monthly production availability.

nfr.title: Security
nfr.acceptance: TLS on ingress and internal production-like traffic, JWT issuer/audience/expiry checked, secrets absent repository/logs, least-privilege DB/broker roles; security scenario suite passes.

nfr.title: Delivery independence
nfr.acceptance: Seven service images and DB migration streams; notification-only release changes no other digest; each service tests/builds/deploys without importing other business implementation.

nfr.title: Accessibility
nfr.acceptance: Keyboard complete customer checkout and operator return; visible focus; labels/errors; no color-only state; contrast normal text≥4.5:1; 360px without horizontal page scroll.

nfr.title: Backup
nfr.acceptance: Snapshot RPO target≤24h; measured isolated restore RTO≤30min for fixture dataset; reconnect mismatched service snapshots through reconcile, report unrecoverable delta.

nfr.title: Data lifecycle
nfr.acceptance: Synthetic users only; auth logs7d, telemetry7d, notifications30d, inbox/idempotency24h minimum with replay rules; booking/ledger retained for lab history; scrub demo emails on exports.

nfr.title: Reproducibility
nfr.acceptance: Clean lab host builds pinned images/contracts; bootstrap docs checked by reviewer; no mandatory external cloud, CDN or paid integration.

# Research & product selection — 11 October 2026

Дата проверки: 2026-10-11, Europe/Tallinn. Метод: целевая качественная выборка страниц работодателей и официальной документации. Это не перепись вакансий и не статистика долей рынка. Поиск смещён к Java, TypeScript и platform; результаты не доказывают превосходство языка или вероятность трудоустройства. География, разрешение на работу, язык и образование требуют отдельной проверки при реальном отклике.

## Наблюдения и выводы

R01 показывает ценность фундаментальных знаний и объяснения решений. R02–R06 дают основания тренировать JVM, SQL, API, review и frontend; senior-позиции используются только как ориентир роста. R07–R09 показывают отдельный путь platform: Linux, сети, IaC, контейнеры, инциденты. Название Junior иногда соседствует с требованием 2 лет, поэтому диплом проекта не равен опыту работы. R10 исключена как закрытая страница. Малое число локальных entry-level находок нельзя трактовать как отсутствие спроса.

Главный учебный результат: объяснимые транзакции, контракт API, диагностика сбоя и воспроизводимый deployment. Количество логотипов инструментов не является результатом. Java/Spring выбирается для core-domain; React/TypeScript — для UI; один TypeScript Notification сервис даёт межъязыковую контрактную практику. Kafka не добавляется в основную систему: RabbitMQ лучше соответствует командам и ограниченной нагрузке, Kafka изучается в сравнительной лаборатории.

## Сравнение предметных областей

Оценки 1–5 — авторское суждение, не измерения рынка. Критерии: коммерческий реализм (C), естественные границы (M), распределённость (D), бизнес-правила (B), четыре направления (E), соответствие задачам вакансий (J), выполнимость одному (S), защита (I). Вес каждого одинаковый; сумма не скрывает trade-offs.

| Вариант | C | M | D | B | E | J | S | I | Итог /40 | Ограничение |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| DepotFlow: B2B аренда оборудования |5|5|5|5|5|4|4|5|38|Временные интервалы и физический возврат усложняют тесты|
| ColdRoute: холодовая логистика |5|5|5|5|5|4|2|5|36|Телеметрия и маршрутизация быстро расширяют scope|
| PermitDesk: разрешения на строительство |5|3|3|5|4|4|4|4|32|Много workflow, меньше естественных конкурентных ресурсов|
| SeatWave: билеты на мероприятия |5|4|5|4|5|4|4|4|35|Хорошая конкуренция, но предметная область часто повторяет учебные проекты|

Выбран DepotFlow: ограниченные физические ресурсы, срок удержания, необратимая выдача и отдельно управляемые платежи дают разные причины распределённости. Это вымышленный продукт с реалистичными правилами, а не утверждение о внутренней архитектуре существующей компании. Для маленького коммерческого стартапа монолит мог бы стоить меньше; здесь микросервисы — явная цель capstone, а границы выбраны по ответственности, а не ради контейнеров.

Исключены: Match Me, marketplace между независимыми арендодателями, реальная обработка карт, налоги по странам, бухгалтерская сертификация, оптимизация маршрутов, IoT. Sandbox PSP и почтовый sink обязательны; настоящие деньги и персональные данные не нужны.

# DepotFlow — Product Requirements Document v1.0

Платформа для сотрудников и корпоративных клиентов одного арендного оператора с несколькими складами. Мультиарендность — несколько независимых организаций оператора в одном SaaS, клиент принадлежит ровно одной организации. Проблема: обещанное наличие расходится с физическими активами, задержки оплаты и ремонта порождают ручные ошибки. Цель: непротиворечивый путь quote → reservation → authorization → handover → return → settlement с диагностируемыми отказами.

## Роли

| Роль | Разрешено | Запрещено |
|---|---|---|
| customer | поиск, свой checkout, свои bookings, отмена до выдачи, свои уведомления | чужие договоры, rates, capture/refund |
| operator | assets и выдача/возврат только назначенного depot | менять тарифы, роли, refund |
| finance | payment/ledger своей организации, refund с причиной | выдача или назначение роли |
| org_admin | membership, rates, audit своей организации | bypass state machine, ручное изменение ledger |
| service principal | только разрешённые internal endpoints/events | вход в UI и действия от имени customer без subject |

Одна активная роль membership; смена роли фиксируется с version. Admin также нуждается в operator membership для физической выдачи (смена роли); superuser обходы запрещены.

## Обязательный scope

F01–F20 — все обязательны. Приоритет P0: F01, F04–F12, F16–F18 (целостность и безопасность); P1: F02–F03, F13–F15, F19–F20 (полноценная эксплуатация). Priority означает порядок реализации, не право выкинуть функциональность. Полные stories в product/stories, machine registry requirements/functional.json.

Основные journeys: клиент находит модель и котировку, получает подтверждение либо понятную причину отказа; оператор видит складские jobs, выдаёт и принимает оборудование; finance разбирает неизвестный PSP результат и выполняет ограниченный refund; admin управляет тарифами, доступом и анализирует историю. Корректность — отсутствие двойного выделения, лишнего списания и межtenant утечек; success screen появляется лишь после authoritative business state.

## Правила продукта

EUR integer minor units; без налогов в core (цены учебные, не бухгалтерский расчёт). Целые qty 1..5; один model/depot/период на booking. Начало ≥ now+1h; duration 1h..30d; interval [start,end), UTC persistence, UI Europe/Tallinn explicit. Price snapshot на 15 min; hold на 10 min, не продлевается heartbeat. Booking сохраняет quote snapshot, Inventory выделяет конкретные assets. Рабочий день аренды — 24 h, округление вверх; DST не меняет длительность UTC. Sandbox authorization действительна 45d, максимум аренды30d. Partial pickup/return и перенос срока — advanced, не core. Все assets возвращаются одним актом.

Срок просрочки: ceil(max(0, return_at-end_at)/24h), grace15 min (если lateness ≤15 min, late_days0; иначе весь lateness округляется). late_charge=late_days*daily_minor*qty. Damage — целое 0..deposit_minor общей котировки, с заметкой; превышение или capture total > authorized -> manual_review. Capture только после return. Нереальные PSP/тарифы явно подписаны.

## Ограничения и допущения

Сервис Fulfillment фиксирует физический факт; потерянный ответ не отменяет состоявшуюся выдачу. При просроченном возврате asset становится unavailable; будущие committed bookings на этот asset получают reconciliation incident, оператор не выдаёт отсутствующий asset и организует ручное замещение/отмену с компенсацией. В core нет гарантии наличия при нарушении клиентом физического срока. Граница учебной и коммерческой инфраструктуры описана в operations/environments.md.

## Out of scope / Advanced

Маркетплейс, реальные карты, real invoices, налоговый движок, кредиты, оптимизация маршрутов, геолокация, multi-currency. Advanced: split return, partial capture, replacement saga, Kafka projection, multi-region. Эти расширения не заменяют обязательные failure scenarios.

## Success

Все F/N/A требования имеют evidence и независимый audit; нет автоматического обещания production-grade SLA. Система production-like: проектирует коммерческие проблемы и тренирует инженерный процесс в измеренной лаборатории.

# Business logic — authoritative process specification

Все часы сохраняются в UTC; deadline проверяет время БД, не браузера. IDs UUID; внешние ссылки принадлежат org. Чтение чужого объекта даёт404; запрещённая операция над своим —403. Проверка membership Tenancy синхронная на каждой изменяющей business command; кеш чтений≤60s. State transition и outbox пишутся одной транзакцией владельца. Inbox уникален (consumer,event_id); ack только после commit. Ниже правила обязательны совместно, не альтернативные варианты.

## P01 — Quote

**Actors / authorization:** customer; Catalog.

**Initial conditions:** active model/rate; trusted org membership.

**Actions / validation:** Validate UTC interval, qty; read rate in one transaction, snapshot price and expires_at. Return201 quote ID.

**States / concurrency / forbidden transitions:** ACTIVE→EXPIRED by time; immutable body. Expired reuse422. Concurrent rate update cannot mix deposit/rental versions.

**Retries / cancellation / partial failure / expected outcome:** Retry create same key returns same quote. Cancel has no side effect; no money reserved. Catalog/DB fail503; UI re-quotes only after user consent.

## P02 — Reserve

**Actors / authorization:** Booking → Inventory.

**Initial conditions:** persisted pending booking; valid quote snapshot.

**Actions / validation:** Publish reserve-requested via outbox; Inventory selects qty assets in ID order, locks asset rows, checks maintenance and allocation overlap, commits all-or-nothing hold+allocation+outbox.

**States / concurrency / forbidden transitions:** REQUESTED→HELD or REJECTED; HELD→COMMITTED/EXPIRED/RELEASED. Tenant+asset+overlap exclusion, maintenance same allocation table. Failure to acquire any unit rolls back all.

**Retries / cancellation / partial failure / expected outcome:** Command identity booking_id. Multiple identical commands return same outcome event with stable ID/outbox identity; different parameters409. Expire sweep locks hold, sets allocation inactive; time guard on commit wins over delayed sweep.

## P03 — Authorize & commit

**Actors / authorization:** Booking → Billing → Inventory.

**Initial conditions:** Held; no cancel requested; deadline=min(holdExpiry, sagaDeadline).

**Actions / validation:** Billing authorizes rental+deposit using provider_key=booking+authorize:v1. Save authorized result/outbox. Booking publishes commit; Inventory under hold lock checks DB time<expires_at and alloc active; emits committed.

**States / concurrency / forbidden transitions:** Booking PENDING→CONFIRMED only after allocation.committed AND authorized intent correlation. Expiry or rejection→COMPENSATING→CANCELLED/FAILED after release+void evidence.

**Retries / cancellation / partial failure / expected outcome:** PSP call may succeed while response lost: UNKNOWN, reconcile query by key; never generate new provider key. Late authorized after compensation -> void. Late committed while cancel intent -> release. Terminal state suppresses stale forward transitions.

## P04 — Cancel

**Actors / authorization:** customer; Booking saga.

**Initial conditions:** own booking pending/confirmed; no handover claim.

**Actions / validation:** Atomic booking lock records cancel_requested and version; emit release+void commands if corresponding steps exist. Confirm completion only with observed allocation released and intent voided/no intent.

**States / concurrency / forbidden transitions:** PENDING/CONFIRMED→CANCELLING→CANCELLED; concurrent handover claim→409. No cancellation after irreversible handover.

**Retries / cancellation / partial failure / expected outcome:** Repeated same cancellation returns same intent. Partial dependency failure leaves CANCELLING and reconciliation age visible; deadline does not imply compensation success. Cancel-before-hold sets tombstone to reject later hold/commit.

## P05 — Handover fence

**Actors / authorization:** operator; Fulfillment + Booking.

**Initial conditions:** same depot, confirmed, active allocation, within pickup window.

**Actions / validation:** Fulfillment calls Booking claim with job_id and expected version. Booking atomic CONFIRMED→HANDOVER_CLAIMED; cancel now forbidden. Fulfillment persists physical act and event; Booking becomes IN_USE after event.

**States / concurrency / forbidden transitions:** CONFIRMED→HANDOVER_CLAIMED→IN_USE. Claim idempotent per job; another job409. Claim without completed act after timeout→MANUAL_REVIEW, no automatic release.

**Retries / cancellation / partial failure / expected outcome:** Before physical transfer verify exact serial IDs locally against immutable confirmed allocation snapshot. Lost claim response re-query; never hand over on timeout. Operator must explicitly resolve claim incident; no TTL unlock of possible physical transfer.

## P06 — Return & quarantine

**Actors / authorization:** operator; Fulfillment → Inventory.

**Initial conditions:** handover act present; same depot; all assets.

**Actions / validation:** One transaction return report+jobReturned+outbox. Inventory marks original allocation inactive, good asset READY, damaged asset QUARANTINED with maintenance block. Emits allocation.released.

**States / concurrency / forbidden transitions:** Job IN_USE→RETURNED; Booking IN_USE→SETTLING. Asset READY→RENTED→READY/QUARANTINED. Out-of-order return before handed-over event requires entity lookup/parking.

**Retries / cancellation / partial failure / expected outcome:** Unique report per job; duplicate same command same report, different body409. If future allocation overlaps new quarantine, do not erase it: mark asset unavailable, incident and notify Booking to stop handover. Settlement blocked until release acknowledged.

## P07 — Settle

**Actors / authorization:** Booking → Billing.

**Initial conditions:** return report and allocation release; authorized intent.

**Actions / validation:** Calculate immutable settlement from quote and return. Capture cost≤authorized; void unused authorization. Persist operation IDs/ledger; reconcile unknown PSP separately.

**States / concurrency / forbidden transitions:** AUTHORIZED→CAPTURE_PENDING→CAPTURED or UNKNOWN; excess→MANUAL_REVIEW. Booking SETTLING→COMPLETED only after captured + remainder void or full void for zero cost.

**Retries / cancellation / partial failure / expected outcome:** Duplicate settlement operation returns prior amount; changed amount409. Capture+void must reconcile independently. Failure does not reallocate returned equipment. Customer sees settlement pending; no phantom complete.

## P08 — Refund

**Actors / authorization:** finance; Billing.

**Initial conditions:** captured remainder>0; reason and If-Match.

**Actions / validation:** Lock intent, reserve refundable amount for pending operation, persist request; invoke PSP stable key outside lock; finalize ledger from response/webhook.

**States / concurrency / forbidden transitions:** CAPTURED→REFUND_PENDING→PARTIALLY_REFUNDED/REFUNDED; UNKNOWN waits reconciliation. captured-refunded-pending_refunds≥0 invariant.

**Retries / cancellation / partial failure / expected outcome:** Concurrent full refunds cannot each reserve same remainder. Cancel refund before provider call optional; after call do not assume cancellation. Duplicate signed webhook unique provider_event_id; conflicting payload quarantined.

## P09 — Repair

**Actors / authorization:** operator; Inventory.

**Initial conditions:** asset not rented; no conflicting committed interval.

**Actions / validation:** Under asset lock create maintenance allocation, asset QUARANTINED; repair records reason and completed inspection; deactivate maintenance block and mark READY.

**States / concurrency / forbidden transitions:** READY→QUARANTINED→READY; cannot jump RENTED→READY without return. Future reservation conflicts return409 with dispatcher action.

**Retries / cancellation / partial failure / expected outcome:** Concurrent maintenance/hold share asset lock and exclusion invariant. Retry same key same maintenance job; changed reason conflicts. Operator access depot-scoped.

## P10 — Notification

**Actors / authorization:** Notification.

**Initial conditions:** recognized event; valid tenant and subject.

**Actions / validation:** Inbox dedupe + notification + delivery plan atomic; sender retries mail sink with stable Message-ID; UI SSE sends IDs and cursor.

**States / concurrency / forbidden transitions:** delivery PENDING→SENT or RETRY→DLQ; read_at independent. Projection versions only advance.

**Retries / cancellation / partial failure / expected outcome:** Duplicates do not produce duplicate UI rows, but external email can duplicate after ambiguous delivery. Retry 5 attempts; inbox replay policy required when retention reached. Disconnect uses HTTP snapshot, no correctness dependency on SSE.

## Booking state machine

PENDING → CONFIRMED | COMPENSATING | CANCELLING; CONFIRMED → HANDOVER_CLAIMED | CANCELLING; HANDOVER_CLAIMED → IN_USE | MANUAL_REVIEW; IN_USE → SETTLING; SETTLING → COMPLETED | MANUAL_REVIEW; CANCELLING/COMPENSATING → CANCELLED/FAILED only after compensation evidence. FAILED/CANCELLED/COMPLETED terminal for forward business changes; late events can still cause compensating commands and audit rows. Refund never changes COMPLETED booking back to SETTLING. Manual review resolutions require reason, role and bounded state transition; no arbitrary status field setter API.

## Event ordering rule

Events carry producer aggregate_version and event_id; facts may arrive late. Consumers dedupe by ID and check event-specific prerequisites. Full snapshot projections ignore lower version; business facts are not discarded solely for low version (a late authorization still needs void). Gap -> park event with reason and perform authoritative GET; retry then DLQ if schema invalid. Commands have command_id plus expected correlation, idempotent by business operation; cancellation tombstone prevents resurrection. No total order across services.

## Physical overrun

Rental interval conflict guarantees promises based on scheduled return, not physically timely return. Sweep after end+15min for IN_USE assets marks unavailable and emits asset.unavailable; future job handover must reject absent asset. Inventory raises incident listing affected bookings. Dispatcher may cancel before claim or perform advanced replacement saga. Do not automatically refund/replace a physical asset silently. Test overrun against future committed allocation explicitly.

## Physical eligibility before claim

Fulfillment GET Inventory /internal/v1/bookings/{booking_id}/handover-check immediately before Booking claim. If not eligible/unavailable, stop; if check succeeds then claim serializes cancellation. Same job serialized at Fulfillment. Inventory consumes handed-over to mark RENTED; late return/handover uses job history not message arrival order. Operator verifies physical serial/condition before actual transfer; this physical check is required even if projection says READY. A failure after claim leaves manual review, not timed auto release.

## Membership safety

Tenancy rejects revocation/demotion of last active org_admin with409 last_admin; locks organization and memberships atomically to prevent concurrent removal of two last admins. Invite/role update cannot assign operator without a valid same-org depot. Audit actor/reason/version persists with membership change. Initial org and first admin are synthetic bootstrap fixtures, not open public sign-up in core.

# System design

Семь бизнес-сервисов: Tenancy, Catalog, Inventory, Booking, Billing, Fulfillment, Notification. PostgreSQL **database per service**, separate roles; один физический instance допустим только dev. Keycloak, gateway, Redis, RabbitMQ, observability — инфраструктура и не считаются бизнес-сервисами. Нет joins, SQL доступов или shared ORM entities между владельцами. Monorepo хранит контракты, но каждый service имеет own build/image/migration/release; общая библиотека допустима для logging/auth plumbing, не domain types.

## Sync / Async

Sync: OIDC discovery/JWKS; Tenancy membership checks; Catalog quote; Inventory availability; Booking handover claim; Billing GET reconciliation; пользовательские queries. Async: reserve/authorize/commit/release/void/settle commands и domain facts. RabbitMQ topic exchange depotflow.events + depotflow.commands; один durable queue per consumer, own DLQ; commands адресуются единственному владельцу, events fan-out. Booking — durable orchestrator saga, нет распределённой транзакции.

Outbox DB poller publishes persistent messages with mandatory routing + publisher confirm; mark published only after confirm; unroutable goes operator alert and stays pending. Crash between confirm and mark creates duplicate — ожидаемо. Inbox/business update/outbox commit атомарны; ack после commit. Доставка at-least-once, business effect effectively once under operation invariants; внешняя почта exactly-once не обещается. Local one-node broker не HA, three-node quorum lab даёт majority replication, не multi-region гарантию.

## Deadline and compensation

Reserve hold10min, quote15min. Saga begins only on valid quote; deadline=hold expiration after HoldCreated, initial request deadline30s to get hold; missing response triggers owner status query by booking_id. Authorize timeout5s; UNKNOWN reconciliation up to hold deadline then cancellation intent; late auth always void. Commit after expiration rejects even if sweeper lagged. Release command creates tombstone even before original reserve; a delayed reserve cannot resurrect booking. Saga scheduler leases rows and resumes after crash; terminal compensation checked from owner APIs, never inferred from timeout.

## Latency budget

External command acceptance ≤500ms target: membership150ms, local DB200ms, gateway overhead50ms, budget reserve100ms. Sync overall deadline2s, connect250ms, request1s for reads; handover claim1s. Max1 retry only for idempotent GET if remaining deadline; writes only stable operation key and owner lookup. PSP call timeout5s, open breaker after5 transport failures in30s, open30s, one half-open probe. Breaker is Billing adapter only: prevents exhausting worker slots, does not make UNKNOWN decline. Async transient retries 1/2/4/8/16s + full jitter[0,base], 5 attempts then DLQ; operator replay original event ID. Backlog oldest age alerts60s; flow control prefetch20, worker concurrency8 first measured then tuned.

## Storage / projections

Inventory authoritative concurrency; Booking owns status, Fulfillment physical act, Billing ledger. Read projections explicitly eventual; UI shows updated_at and pending, retry status via GET. Redis only Catalog model-list cache and gateway rate limiter, never allocation correctness. Cache keys include org+filter+cursor+rateVersion; TTL60s, invalidation on catalog.changed; quote calculates from DB, no stale pricing. Redis failure -> bounded SQL read, rate limit local emergency low cap with metric; never fail open on authorization.

## Scalability and evolution

Start with HTTP/REST (OpenAPI) and AMQP (AsyncAPI). No gRPC in core: no measured throughput justification and second transport hurts solo debugging. Comparative lab defines protobuf availability query, measures payload/latency and explains why it may remain out of core. Seven Java/Node services fit a lab with constrained memory profiles; do not claim autoscaling from replicas alone. Inventory can partition contention by depot; global date queries need index/query plans before sharding. Keep architecture same while implementing services sequentially.

## Source diagrams

architecture/diagrams/*.json are editable layout + semantic edges; *.svg are rendered standalone, captions specify design targets, not live deployments. Separate ER per owner and component/sequence/failure variants. diagrams/index.json maps sources to SVG and document.

Java21, Spring Boot4.1 family, Maven wrapper, Spring Security, JDBC explicit transactions, Flyway; pin patch and image digests at M01.
JDBC selected over automatic ORM cascades for visible locking and aggregate transitions; ORM alternative allowed after ADR preserving SQL invariants.

## Data ownership / schema
Database: tenancy_db. Role: tenancy_app. No credentials for other owners.

| Table | Logical columns |
|---|---|
|organizations|id, name, status, version|
|memberships|id, org_id, subject_id, role, depot_id?, status, version|
|audit_entries|id, org_id, actor_id, action, target_id, occurred_at|

Logical model, types/indexes/constraints in data/models/tenancy.md and ER source. Migration implementation remains student work.

## HTTP contract
[OpenAPI](../../contracts/openapi/tenancy.json); public and internal operations clearly tagged. The API is a design specification, not a running server.

## Events / dependencies
Publishes: membership.changed. Consumes: none.
[Per-service AsyncAPI](../../contracts/asyncapi/tenancy.json). Dependencies follow named commands/GETs; all services depend on Tenancy for mutation authorization, Keycloak JWKS, own DB and telemetry. Catalog/Notification use Redis/SSE as specified; Billing alone calls PSP; Fulfillment claims Booking; Booking fetches immutable Catalog quote snapshot and owner recovery status.

## Failure behavior
Недоступность Tenancy блокирует новые бизнес-команды (503), чтения возможны с membership snapshot не старше 60 s.

## Metrics and scaling
authorization_denied_total; membership_check_seconds. Stateless HTTP replicas; membership lookup indexes; no shared auth cache without bounded revocation.

## Service-specific checks
Два tenant, отозванная роль, чужой depot, audit without token data.

## Configuration / identity
Env names: SERVICE_PORT, DB_URL, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD_FILE, AMQP_URL, OIDC_ISSUER, OIDC_AUDIENCE, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, LOG_LEVEL. Private credentials via mounted secret, no committed .env with secrets. Validate required config at startup; store exact versions/digests in implementation lock file at M01. HTTP resource server JWT issuer/audience/expiry; internal credentials scoped per caller; tenant/subject contextual authorization survives gateway. Membership authoritative check on business writes. Broker ACL read/write only named queues/exchanges.

## Errors / health / deployment
RFC-style problem response: type, title, status, code, correlationId, violations (safe paths only); stable codes in contracts. 401 invalid auth;403 forbidden own resource;404 missing/foreign;409 business conflict;412 stale version;422 semantic validation;428 missing precondition;429 throttled;503 unavailable dependency. Liveness checks process only; startup validates migrations/config; readiness DB reachable, essential HTTP workers ready; broker outage marks async degradation and metrics, does not restart all services. Non-root container, readonly root filesystem, writable temp only, graceful drain30s; separate migration job; requests/limits measured in M15. Own image deployable without rebuilding peers.

## Private persistence / messaging
Each owner additionally has outbox(event_id UNIQUE, aggregate_id, payload, status, created_at), inbox(consumer,event_id UNIQUE, received_at), idempotency(org,subject,route,key UNIQUE, request_hash, response, expires_at). A service without outbound messages need not create outbox. Producer aggregate_version monotonic per aggregate; command_id stable across redelivery; consumer dedupe persists with business changes. No foreign-service DB permissions. Foreign IDs are opaque and validated via contract, no cross-DB FK.

## Test suite
Unit: pure transition rules, validation and money boundaries. Integration: PostgreSQL real transactions and migrations via Testcontainers; RabbitMQ ack/confirm tests where used. Contract: generated schema fixtures and provider/consumer compatibility. E2E: only exposed APIs and owned-state diagnostic reports, never foreign DB writes. Include tenant isolation, dependency timeout, duplicate and restart tests. Expose metrics without customer/booking high-cardinality labels; JSON logs with trace_id and correlation_id but no JWT or PII. See reviews/test-strategy.md.

# Technology map

Core stack is selected, not everything listed is installed. Jenkins, gRPC, Kafka are comparative labs; service mesh, Redis Streams, BullMQ are evaluated alternatives, no mandatory installation. Version locks recorded by student M01; this pack includes no running backend.

## Java21 + Spring Boot

**Problem:** Типизированные domain rules, transactions/security. **Decision:** use in Backend. **Alternatives:** Node/Nest, .NET, Go. **Limits:** JVM memory and library compatibility; pin Boot4.1 patch.

**Study:** HTTP lifecycle, DI, JDBC transaction boundary. **Practice result:** M03 quote API and unit/integration suite. **Understanding check:** Explain rollback when exception is swallowed.

## REST / OpenAPI

**Problem:** Явные HTTP contracts. **Decision:** use in Backend. **Alternatives:** gRPC/protobuf lab. **Limits:** No streaming optimization; breaking semantics need version.

**Study:** status codes, caching, deadlines, idempotency. **Practice result:** M06 generated fixtures/provider checks. **Understanding check:** Explain why POST timeout does not mean failure.

## React / TypeScript

**Problem:** Accessible role-based UI and server-state handling. **Decision:** use in Frontend. **Alternatives:** Vue/Svelte. **Limits:** UI types do not validate network at runtime.

**Study:** router, TanStack Query, forms, runtime validation. **Practice result:** M11 checkout and operator E2E. **Understanding check:** Distinguish UI optimistic cache from booking authority.

## PostgreSQL / Flyway

**Problem:** Owned durable aggregates and interval integrity. **Decision:** use in Databases. **Alternatives:** MySQL; ORM; Liquibase. **Limits:** Physical instance shared dev still has one failure domain.

**Study:** SQL, MVCC, locks, exclusion, plans, migration. **Practice result:** M04 contention and query evidence. **Understanding check:** Explain write skew and why Redis lock is insufficient.

## Redis

**Problem:** Bounded catalog cache and gateway throttling. **Decision:** use in Caching. **Alternatives:** in-process, HTTP ETag; no cache. **Limits:** Eviction and stale data; never inventory truth.

**Study:** TTL, memory max, noeviction vs allkeys-lru, persistence. **Practice result:** M11 cache outage/rebuild lab. **Understanding check:** Prove stale cache cannot change quote price.

## RabbitMQ

**Problem:** Durable routed commands/events, DLQ. **Decision:** use in Messaging. **Alternatives:** Kafka lab; Redis Streams; BullMQ. **Limits:** Queue topology and confirms need explicit ops.

**Study:** acks, confirms, routing, prefetch, quorum. **Practice result:** M06 outbox/inbox crash replay. **Understanding check:** Explain confirm success without consumer business effect.

## Kafka comparative lab

**Problem:** Replayable depot utilization projection. **Decision:** use in Messaging. **Alternatives:** RabbitMQ append-only event archive. **Limits:** Not installed core; partitions and rebalance costs.

**Study:** offsets, key ordering, retention, group rebalances. **Practice result:** M14 comparative failure report. **Understanding check:** Explain ordering per key vs global ordering.

## Keycloak / OIDC

**Problem:** Authentication without home-made password flow. **Decision:** use in Security. **Alternatives:** managed IdP; session BFF. **Limits:** IdP availability and token revocation semantics.

**Study:** PKCE, JWKS rotation, JWT audience, RBAC. **Practice result:** M02 two tenants and revoke role. **Understanding check:** Explain authentication vs membership authorization.

## Linux / DNS / TLS / Nginx

**Problem:** Runtime process/network and edge routing. **Decision:** use in Linux. **Alternatives:** Caddy, Traefik. **Limits:** Need operational skills, not host security changes here.

**Study:** users, signals, sockets, DNS, certificates. **Practice result:** M01 lab and M15 network packet evidence. **Understanding check:** Explain DNS failure vs HTTP503 vs connection refused.

## Docker / Compose

**Problem:** Repeatable local dependencies and images. **Decision:** use in Containers. **Alternatives:** Podman. **Limits:** Volumes consume disk; Compose not HA.

**Study:** layers, nonroot, networks, bind/volume, health. **Practice result:** M01 immutable image and clean environment. **Understanding check:** Explain restart vs recreation vs lost volume.

## Kubernetes / Helm

**Problem:** Independent deployments, probes and rollback. **Decision:** use in Containers. **Alternatives:** Compose on VM; Nomad. **Limits:** Cluster overhead; DB HA not supplied by StatefulSet.

**Study:** requests/limits, services, rollout, policies, storage. **Practice result:** M15 kind/k3d deployment report. **Understanding check:** Explain readiness vs liveness with broker down.

## GitHub Actions

**Problem:** Repeatable changed-service checks and deploy. **Decision:** use in Delivery. **Alternatives:** GitLab CI; Jenkins lab. **Limits:** Remote runner costs/permissions, local fallback scripts.

**Study:** DAG, caches, artifacts, OIDC, environment gates. **Practice result:** M16 service-specific release and rollback. **Understanding check:** Explain why path filter can miss shared contract changes.

## OpenTofu / Ansible

**Problem:** Cloud resource state + repeatable VM configuration. **Decision:** use in IaC. **Alternatives:** Terraform; cloud-native IaC. **Limits:** State secrets/lock, billing; Ansible not resource graph.

**Study:** plan/state/drift; idempotent playbooks. **Practice result:** M17 sandbox plan and local VM convergence. **Understanding check:** Explain IaC state vs actual resources and second run.

## AWS optional sandbox

**Problem:** VPC/IAM/storage and cost reasoning. **Decision:** use in Cloud. **Alternatives:** Azure/GCP; mandatory local equivalent. **Limits:** Real account optional and spending approval required.

**Study:** subnets, IAM, budgets, destroy, quotas. **Practice result:** M17 local simulation or authorized sandbox report. **Understanding check:** Explain single VM production-like single failure point.

## OpenTelemetry / Prometheus / Grafana / Loki / Tempo

**Problem:** Trace slow saga with metrics and logs. **Decision:** use in Observability. **Alternatives:** Jaeger, ELK. **Limits:** Storage/label cardinality cost; sampling changes visibility.

**Study:** trace context, histograms, exemplars, alerts. **Practice result:** M12 diagnose poisoned event with correlation. **Understanding check:** Find trace across async edge without logging JWT.

## JUnit / Testcontainers / Playwright / k6 / ZAP

**Problem:** Verify real transactions, UI, load and access attacks. **Decision:** use in Testing. **Alternatives:** Vitest, Gatling, Locust. **Limits:** Tests consume resources; synthetic fixture only.

**Study:** test levels, fault injection, percentiles, attack scope. **Practice result:** M14 reproducible failure/performance evidence. **Understanding check:** Explain why 100% line coverage does not prove invariants.

## ADRs / threat model / contract review

**Problem:** Document costs and reversible decisions. **Decision:** use in System Design. **Alternatives:** design review notes. **Limits:** Documentation must track actual change.

**Study:** ownership, consistency, recovery, architecture audit. **Practice result:** M18 defend failure decisions. **Understanding check:** Explain where strong consistency ends and manual review begins.

none. Прочитать product/business-processes.md и соответствующие service passports/контракты. Перед практикой объяснить незнакомые термины; не копировать готовое бизнес-решение.

Build isolated lab; pin versions; seven empty service build boundaries; dependency Compose specification; no business implementation supplied.

## Functional Requirements
DNS/ports explained; clean machine instructions; each image independently builds. Связанные требования: A03/A05 platform acceptance.

## Constraints
Семь независимых владельцев данных; никакого shared database access или подмены backend+worker. Бизнес-код пишет студент. Все retries ограничены, деньги integer, состояния durable, tenant checks server-side. Только sandbox, синтетические данные, isolated lab. Не менять личные VM/credentials/main/remote для выполнения учебного этапа.

## Expected Deliverables
Architecture skeleton, version lock, resource inventory, environment README. Дополнительно: README воспроизведения с местом запуска каждой команды и смыслом аргументов, evidence/M01/manifest.json (commit, image digests, CPU/RAM, dataset seed, UTC time), raw test outputs, ADR если изменились границы.

## Acceptance Criteria
One independent build per service; no shared DB role; dependency health evidence.

Для каждого связанного F/N требования повторить соответствующий Given/When/Then. Показать независимый запуск теста и состояние после операции, не только HTTP response. Результат = pass/failed/blocked с ссылкой на evidence; непроверенное не pass.

## Testing Scenarios
Positive: DNS/ports explained; clean machine instructions; each image independently builds. Negative: forbidden tenant/role, malformed body, unavailable required owner, conflicting operation. Unit tests не заменяют DB/transport experiments.

Kill local lab process; distinguish socket absence from health response. Записать trigger → observed state → recovery → invariant checks. Рестарт контейнера должен сохранять committed state. Отказ воспроизводится в изолированной среде без удаления чужих данных.

Explain namespaces, loopback, TLS; show git diff and reproducible clean start. Reviewer выбирает один негативный сценарий сам, читает transaction boundary, проверяет ownership credentials и контракт. Нельзя пройти этап только по screenshot/green checkbox.

## Definition of Done
Lab footprint report; one nonroot image runs; documentation covers every command. Deliverables доступны, acceptance evidence со стабильными IDs, review замечания resolved или explicit limitation, clean-start инструкции повторены. Правила Ready/Done в operations/engineering-process.md.

Native image comparison with measured memory. Bonus после обязательных проверок; записать ADR и сравнение, не добавлять инструмент без сценария.

# Environment and deployment specification

These are target designs; nothing provisioned by this assignment pack. Windows edits/viewing; Linux lab (WSL2 or isolated VM) is where future Docker/Kubernetes commands run. Do not modify current personal VMs or system settings without approval. Student measures available CPU/RAM first.

| Profile | Budget assumption | Topology | Purpose / limitation |
|---|---|---|---|
| lab-lite |4vCPU,8GB,20GB free|Compose subsets, JVM Xmx192m initially, DB instance separate owned DBs|First milestones; no full stack SLA benchmark|
| lab-standard |8vCPU,16GB,40GB free|7services, own DBs one Postgres node,1Rabbit,1Redis,Keycloak, telemetry|Fixed N01 load and restore fixture, no HA|
| lab-cluster |8vCPU,24GB,60GB free|kind/k3d3nodes, replicas2 core where needed,3Rabbit quorum, own DB credentials|Failure experiments; nodes share host failure domain|
| production-like |Same cluster or isolated VM|TLS, independent images, migration jobs, policies, backup target separate volume|Demonstrate operations; no production uptime claim|
| optional AWS |User authorized sandbox budget only|VPC private subnets, ingress VM/load balancer, storage, IAM, budget alarm|Live cloud requires measured cost/cleanup; not performed by author|

Requests starting values per JVM cpu100m/memory256Mi, limits cpu1/memory512Mi; Node100m/128Mi to1/256Mi. These values must be profiled, not assumed stable for chosen framework. DB/Rabbit/Keycloak needs separate limits and volume budgets; resource sum recorded, OOMKilled evidence changes settings. Startup probe every5s up to120s; readiness DB/pool every5s with3fail; liveness process every10s with3fail. Broker fault must not restart entire fleet. terminationGracePeriod30s, preStop stops command acceptance/consumers then drains transaction≤20s. pdb minAvailable1 only with2 replicas, not magic protection for one pod.

Ingress443 only; internal HTTP8080 over TLS production-like. Own DB5432, broker5671, Redis6379 TLS as supported/configured, OTel4317; admin ports only loopback in dev. Default deny in cluster, explicit connection matrix operations/network-security.md. Keycloak persisted independently, never share service DB users. Migrations per owner init/job before rollout; conflicting migration workers serialized. Persistent volumes require backups; StatefulSet doesn't supply DB replication automatically.

Compose design: networks edge, app, data, telemetry; only gateway connects edge/app, service joins app+own data, expose no DB/broker publicly. Compose networks not a strong per-service firewall; DB grants and OS/cluster policy provide real denial tests. Compose manifest is student deliverable M01; no pretend deploy YAML with missing application images shipped here.

# Allowed connections / threat model

| Caller | Destination | Protocol | Authorization |
|---|---|---|---|
| Browser | gateway / IdP |HTTPS443|PKCE, user access token in memory; CSP, strict CORS, no secrets in browser|
| gateway |7HTTP services|HTTPS internal|JWT forwarded; gateway strips spoofed X-Org/X-User|
| every service |Tenancy membership, Keycloak JWKS|HTTPS|scoped service identity + original subject; issuer/audience validated|
| Booking |Catalog quote lookup, Inventory/Billing status|HTTPS|booking service scope plus tenant|
| Fulfillment |Booking claim/status|HTTPS|fulfillment scope plus operator/depot|
| Tenancy |Inventory depot lookup|HTTPS|tenancy scope plus org|
| each service |own Postgres only|TLS5432|own app role; DDL migration role separate|
| event services |RabbitMQ|AMQPS5671|per-service ACL, commands address owner|
| Catalog/gateway |Redis|TLS6379|named ACL prefixes; no auth source|
| Billing |sandbox PSP|HTTPS|secret, provider idempotency key, signed callbacks|
| Notification |mail sink|SMTP internal|synthetic recipient; stable Message-ID|
| services |OTel collector|gRPC/HTTPS4317|internal identity; PII filter|
| collectors |Prometheus/Loki/Tempo|internal|no public dashboards without operator auth|

Default deny elsewhere. No cross-owner SQL, no direct client DB/broker, no management ingress on public network. TLS cert rotation exercise; service credentials have distinct audiences/scopes and network source alone does not authorize command.

Threats and tests: object authorization(IDOR)→two-tenant endpoint/event/SSE suite N03; role revocation→authoritative command check F01; forged tenant headers→gateway strip plus server derivation; forged PSP callback→HMAC timestamp within5min constant-time verification, unique provider_event_id; replay older signed callback→idempotency not duplicate money; SSRF→no user-controlled outbound URL; SQLi→parameterized queries; XSS→text output and CSP, no unsafe HTML user content; log leakage→scan token-like fixtures; resource exhaustion→body max64KB, per-org rate limits (20read/s,5command/s baseline), bounded thread/consumer pools; dependency attack→lockfile/SBOM/scan and signature/digest review.

TLS certificates/secrets in mounted file or secret store, not ConfigMap; rotate one principal at time with overlap, prove old revoked. Access token short-lived5min, no JWT/email in localStorage/logs. Frontend runtime auth remains memory; refresh via secure approach documented by student (BFF HttpOnly SameSite or IdP flow); prototype uses no authentication and is labeled as demonstration. Minimal synthetic data retention N11; legal compliance of a real business is out of scope, not asserted.

Additional allowed sync edge: Fulfillment → Inventory handover-check HTTPS, scope fulfillment and original operator/depot; failure blocks physical transfer.

# Engineering process / onboarding

Monorepo target: apps/web, services/{tenancy,catalog,inventory,booking,billing,fulfillment,notification}, contracts, platform/{compose,helm,iac,ansible}, docs, tests/{contract,e2e,load,resilience}, evidence. This pack is specification only; student creates implementation repository separately. No Git initialization/commit/push performed here.

Small trunk-based changes on codex/<topic> (or team convention), PR to protected main, no direct main writes. Feature flag incomplete behavior; each PR one explainable risk. Commit reviewed by student, no automatic commit/push by tutor. Independent semantic image tag + immutable digest per service, package source commit recorded.

Coding: strict TS, no any to bypass network validation; Java explicit aggregate boundaries and constructor dependencies; controller validates transport, domain enforces invariants, repository owns SQL; never call PSP under long DB transaction. Formatting automated per language, meaningful tests for invariants. Money utility immutable, no duplicated arithmetic assumptions. Error codes stable; logs JSON, no tokens. Graceful shutdown/health per passport.

Definition of Ready: requirement ID and intent, contract/state impact, fixtures, negative/failure acceptance, known dependencies, reviewable scope. Definition of Done: code + own migration + contract review + positive/negative/failure evidence + docs/diagram updates + clean-start + reviewer approval + known limitation entry. Coverage percentage/checkbox alone not Done.

PR checklist: ownership intact? who can call? race proof? operation key stable? timeout unknown? outbox/inbox transaction boundaries? retry bounded? schema old reader compatibility? resource/log/security impact? deployment/rollback and migration evidence? Student must explain without generated answer memorization.

Backlog epics: E01 Identity/catalog M01–M03; E02 Inventory/booking M04–M05; E03 Delivery/saga M06–M08; E04 Warehouse/finance M09–M10; E05 UI/telemetry M11–M12; E06 Reliability/platform M13–M17; E07 Audit M18. Stories F01–F20 map to milestones; each milestone splits tasks: design contract, implement owner, validate negative/fault, reviewer evidence. Tasks have unique <Mxx>-T01..T04, no generic done flag without tests.

Contract review: proposed change, old/new examples, semantics/authorization, impacted consumers, compatibility fixture gate. Optional fields are additive only if old reader ignores unknown fields; new enum values may break generated exhaustive clients -> deploy tolerant reader first. Breaking event type new major, coexist ≥two releases, do not delete v1 until all consumers upgraded and DLQ/history migration decided. Data migrations expand(add nullable/new table)→dual write/backfill measured idempotently→switch reader→contract later release; backward compatible rollback uses old image with expanded schema. No drop/rename in same release.

Onboarding: read README/PRD, run dependency checks in isolated lab, compare ER/contract to story, implement M01 then follow DAG; explain each shell command before using it. Tutor sequence: explanation → independent practice → inspect evidence → error analysis → skill confirmation. If implementation is requested later, don't supply full solution unless user explicitly asks. Keep evidence raw; failed experiment teaches more than guessed success.

# Release and rollback runbook

Owner: implementing engineer; reviewer verifies evidence. Trigger: per-service change with tests and contract compatibility accepted. Record environment, previous and new digest, migration version, UTC start, operator, backup checkpoint. Precheck previous consumer runs expanded schema, image SBOM scan no untriaged critical issues, essential secrets mounted, no destructive migration. Migration job completes once for owner; failure halts rollout and preserves previous image.

Deploy one service digest. Check readiness and smoke commands through gateway with synthetic org; examine eligible error rate, queue age, saga latency for5min at fixed workload. Threshold trigger: readiness unavailable>60s OR eligible errors>5% for2min OR integrity failure any count. Halt and restore previous image digest; do not undo compatible expand migration. Drain new pods; confirm old replica healthy, retry stable operation IDs, inspect unknown provider ops. Reconcile in-flight saga before declaring recovery. Record actual metrics and owner states.

If data corruption or incompatible destructive migration already occurred: stop mutations, preserve logs/volumes, incident lead decides restore+reconcile from isolated backup; simple image rollback cannot fix data. Never auto replay charge with new key. Release checklist: tests/contract/scan evidence, migration compatibility, artifact digest, deploy scope, smoke, observation, rollback ready, docs updated. Notification-only release must leave six business service digests identical F19.

# Backup & recovery plan

Target N10: snapshot RPO≤24h, fixture measured RTO≤30min; no monthly production guarantee. Back up each owned DB including inbox/outbox/saga/idempotency and Billing pending operations, Keycloak config/store, broker topology definitions, version manifest. Broker queue snapshot alone insufficient for domain recovery; outbox is durable source. Redis cache rebuilds, not backed up for correctness. Store encrypted artifacts on independent lab volume, checksum and restore-test; 7daily+4weekly retention assumption. Credentials outside backup report, authorized only.

Consistent cut workflow: stop incoming mutation acceptance, let current transactions drain, record global maintenance watermark and per-owner DB snapshot time/WAL position; snapshot all owners and topology; release traffic after checkpoints saved. An advanced live-backup exercise uses unequal cut times and must reconcile, not pretend global atomicity.

Restore isolated namespace from manifest, verify checksums, own DB grants and schema, keep consumers/external delivery disabled. Run invariant queries via owner's audit interface: overlap0, captured/refunded bounds, counts at checkpoint, saga phase correlation. Compare PSP sandbox operations by stable key; snapshot may predate successful charge. Reconcile pending intents before consumers on, then resume outbox/inbox preserving IDs. External email may duplicate after old snapshot — report. Rescan terminal compensation and future unavailable asset jobs. Do not restore directly over running original environment.

Evidence: UTC downtime start/end, bytes/counts per owner, chosen snapshot and actual delta, failed restore attempt if any, measured RTO/RPO, recovered IDs, sandbox ledger reconciliation, release of mutation traffic. Missing/corrupt backup is failure; do not declare recovery based on container health. Exercise delete only explicitly named isolated test volume with verified path/namespace, never personal VMs or original data.

# Test strategy and benchmark methodology

Unit tests pure pricing/state rules fast per service; Integration real Postgres/Rabbit/Redis with Testcontainers includes lock contention and ack/confirm boundaries; contracts old consumer/provider fixtures; E2E gateway/UI synthetic tenants; security auth/input/outbound cases; resilience deterministic hooks/barriers at transaction boundaries; k6 load healthy vs degraded. No minimum line-coverage number masquerades as correctness. Critical invariants and transitions must each have at least one counterexample test and positive proof.

Fixture seed20261011: org A/B; depots Tallinn/Tartu; model drill (€25/day,€100deposit), qty1 scarce asset, qty5 pool, damaged and maintenance assets; customer Alice/Bob, operator Tallinn/Tartu, finance/admin. Money amounts synthetic. Dataset baseline100 models,1000assets,10000bookings; query-plan lab100k rows separate from N01 baseline. Clocks configurable injected UTC; simulation now2026-11-02T08:00:00Z; production uses DB clock.

N01 benchmark lab-standard manifest: CPU/RAM, OS/runtime/image versions, load generator separate process, no internet PSP, fixed seed/dataset, warmup2min, steady10min20VU, mixed workload70% read20% checkout/cancel10% warehouse/finance scripted valid steps. Measure API acceptance separately from saga completed, error denominator eligible requests excludes deliberate409/422/auth failures but includes dependency5xx. Export raw samples, count/errors, p50/p95/p99, histogram, resources/queue age. Three runs report each and variability, no fictional averages. Healthy saga p95≤5s; deadline10min not performance success. Stress grows load5VU steps until saturation; results measured, no target user count beyond baseline.

Faults: Rabbit unreachable120s, kill consumer after DB commit beforeACK, outbox publisher after confirm, PSP outcome response lost, invalid webhook, Redis eviction/down, DB lock timeout/deadlock, slow Tenancy, late/out-of-order events, pod rollout, missing volume in isolated restore. Record invariant before/during/after, recovery time and pending states. Acceptance comparisons always same hardware/workload, and architecture claims limited to experiment. Scan security only explicitly lab URLs, never public employers/sites.

Commands are future implementation convention, **not existing runnable business tests in this pack**: ./mvnw -pl services/inventory verify (Linux repo root; -pl selects module, verify executes test lifecycle); npm run test:e2e -- --project=chromium (web repo; Playwright project); k6 run -e BASE_URL=https://lab.local tests/load/checkout.js (-e sets lab target); kubectl rollout status deployment/booking -n depotflow (-- namespace selects isolated lab). # Reviewer guide

Do not accept a feature solely because endpoint returns200. Check owner state, actual foreign-data denial, stable retry identity and independent artifact. Every milestone has reviewer questions; answers deliberately not supplied so student must reason. Ask transaction boundary: what happened if crash one instruction earlier/later? Which state could be unknown? Who owns correction? What proof supports the claim?

Typical errors: shared ORM tables masquerade as microservices; gateway auth only; availability query used as final lock; preACK before DB commit; outbox row marked before confirm; discard every low-version event and miss late auth void; Redis expiry mistaken for business release; cancelling handover claim on TTL despite physical action; generated enum rejects additive event; image rollback after schema drop; source token in trace; pod readiness cited as restore proof.

Technical probes: contrast Read Committed and serializable write skew; show range constraint; explain PSP response-loss and provider key; explain duplicate business effect vs external email; draw consumer transaction; trace wrong tenant header; debug partial restore; explain p95/error denominator; show an actual independent Notification deploy with six unchanged images. Change requirements mid-review: partial return, multi-currency, depot transfer, rate update during quote, provider authorization expiry. Ask student which contract/state/ADR/migration changes first and which old consumer still runs.

Grading: pass only when reproducible evidence meets all required criteria; failed integrity/security blocks stage. Performance miss requires profile/tune or explicit reviewer-approved environment adjustment with rerun; no silent lowered threshold. Optional tasks never compensate for missing core. Review record requires requirement ID, evidence path, reviewer, date, verdict and limitation.

# Contract conventions

OpenAPI3.1.1 JSON per service; AsyncAPI3.0 JSON per application; standalone JSON Schema2020-12 events in data/events. Design baseline only. Seven specs include all public/internal core operations. health/metrics infrastructure endpoints not business contracts. Placeholder .invalid DNS is deliberately non-routable. Gateway route mapping must avoid identical /v1 paths by prefix /api/{service}; frontend client generated accordingly.

Idempotency-Key required on business commands, length8..128; scope(org,subject,route,key), retention24h. Hash canonical JSON+route, durable response after commit; processing returns202 stable operation URL, same key/hash repeats, mismatch409. Retry after retention requires authoritative query first; retaining inbox longer than maximum DLQ replay horizon mandatory. Default inbox keep30d for history replay (N11 specifies minimum24h); older replay to rebuild projection uses new consumer namespace with no external side effects, not clearing existing inbox. Event archive retention30d lab, raw PII avoided.

If-Match quoted aggregate version on mutable updates/cancel/refund/physical forms. Missing428, stale412; intentional business conflict409. API status lookup returns authoritative state/version/updated_at. List cursor opaque signed org+filter+stable(created_at,id), limit default25 max100, no offset duplication during append. Authorization matrix PRD; list filters cannot widen own user/depot scope. Public tenant context derived from verified membership, never caller-supplied org. Internal X-Org/X-Subject are contextual claims and must match caller scope, token and original authorized subject. Browser cannot call internal routes.

Common error codes: invalid_auth, forbidden, not_found, idempotency_mismatch, inventory_conflict, hold_expired, cannot_cancel, handover_claimed, stale_version, validation_failed, precondition_required, rate_limited, dependency_unavailable, payment_unknown. Safe violations with paths; no stack traces/tokens. 429/503 Retry-After seconds, finite retry budget. Money EUR integer minor units, timestamps RFC3339 UTC; UUID identifiers.

Envelope mandatory event_id/type/schema_version/producer/org_id/aggregate_id/version/occurred_at/correlation/causation/data; traceparent optional but injected SDK required for instrumented flows. Commands data.command_id stable per business operation, never changed to defeat dedupe. Routing key type includes .v1. No implicit ordering across queues; fact handlers check prerequisites, project snapshots version-monotonic, late facts may trigger compensation. Async spec is not broker config; topology file defines queues/bindings/DLQ.

Backward compatibility: tolerant consumer ignores unknown optional fields, validates mandatory known ones; transport schemas remain closed in fixtures for drift detection. Introducing optional field requires old consumer proof, not simply saying JSON is extensible. Meaning/type/removal changes major v2; old/new coexist2releases, migration/runbook covers DLQ and event archive. All events from SERVICE registry must have schema, producer and consumer or documented external projection. Contract check helper verifies refs and schema shape; formal parser validation status documented in QA report, not inferred from JSON syntax.

Sandbox PSP adapter contract: authorize(key,amount,currency,expiry45d), query(key), capture(key,amount), void(key,remaining), refund(key,amount). Deterministic controls success/decline/processed-response-loss/delayed-webhook; signed callback uses timestamp and raw payload HMAC, test secrets generated in isolated lab. No real payment integration provided. Settlement remainder void emits payment.voided(kind=remainder); cancellation needs full void/no capture; Booking completes only after capture and remaining_authorization_minor0. Authorization validity shorter than max rental would require reauthorization saga, excluded by45d sandbox assumption.

# Product design specification — DepotFlow

Visual prototype: design/prototype.html; entirely offline, synthetic data and simulated state. It is a reference for independent React implementation, not the backend. Screens mapped in screens.json to F/M IDs. Editable HTML/CSS/JS source and rendered SVG architecture diagrams supplied; Figma unnecessary.

## Information architecture / journeys

Customer: catalog → availability → quote → checkout → pending → booking detail → cancel or settlement; notifications accessible from header. Operator: warehouse jobs → handover inspection → return → fleet/quarantine → maintenance. Finance: payment list → ledger → refund/manual review. Admin: team → role/depot assignment → catalog/rates → audit. Login/denied common. Role selector is a demonstration control, not authentication. Switch to role before screen; permissions enforced later in API.

## Design system

Palette: canvas#f4f6f7, ink#132a39, muted#526570, border#d4dfe4, brand#075d64, accent#b45512, danger#b42318, surface#ffffff, focus#1d70b8. Typography system Segoe UI/Arial offline; body16px line1.55, headings32/24/18px; tabular money/numbers. Spacing4/8/12/16/24/32; radius12 cards,8inputs/buttons; max content1240px; desktop sidebar232px + fluid main; mobile bottom-friendly full-width actions, single column≤720px. Customer forms put price/status alongside desktop, below on mobile; sticky summary never hides field focus.

Components: labeled text/date/qty/money field + help/error IDs; button primary/secondary/danger/loading disabled; breadcrumb; badge with text; table with header/empty/loading pagination; filter bar; status timeline; confirmation dialog; alert role/status aria-live; accessible tabs; progress indicator; notification card; code/correlation ID; responsive asset checklist. Dialog traps focus/escape closes and restores trigger in student implementation. Prototype uses inline review/confirm screen instead of inaccessible faux modal.

## State specification

Loading: skeleton or labeled progress, preserve layout, no duplicate submit. Empty: catalog suggests clear filters; warehouse says no pending jobs, no fake success. Error: stable problem code, correlation and retry safe only per operation ID. Unauthorized: login action401; denied403 explains required role/depot without foreign data. Quote expired: refresh and compare changed amount, requires user consent. Pending: outcome unknown, no success badge; manual review has explanation and contact operator. Success: confirmed only on allocation+auth proof; refund pending until authoritative event. Offline/SSE stale: updated_at banner plus snapshot recovery, never replay checkout automatically.

Accessibility target N09: WCAG-oriented keyboard journeys, explicit labels/errors, visible focus, no color-only statuses, text contrast≥4.5:1, reduced motion; touch targets≥44px. Implementation audit checks real assistive behavior; prototype visual QA is not certification. Tables scroll within region on narrow screens, no document horizontal overflow. Notification includes textual changed state rather than animation.

Screen / acceptance mapping screens.json; prototype controls navigate all screens and demonstrate loading/empty/error/success/denied/reconnecting. Prices/entities labeled demo; sample booking confirmed only by explicit simulated advance action. Persistent project progress belongs atlas, not business state. No forms send network requests.
